ACT rule coverage

Grouped by W3C ACT rule, so engines are compared on the same test. Every rule links to its authoritative W3C page — check the rule text before treating a single-engine finding as a false positive or a missed detection.

An engine that reports nothing is silent, not passing. Silence can mean not applicable, not implemented, no target found, or a missed detection; only a human can tell them apart. Findings include observations whose target could not be resolved; the target count includes only resolved targets.
